messages:
Maya Chen: Quick UX check: noticed a few friction points between the console UI copy and the in-product docs flyout for Routes. Users are getting mixed signals when they try to pin models.
Ravi Patel: can you paste the exact mismatches?
Maya Chen: sure. In the flyout we call things 'Variant' and 'Runtime tier'. In the main Routes page we label them 'Serving variant' and 'Capacity tier'. Two users opened tickets yesterday thinking they needed to select the 'Capacity tier' to pin a model.
Clara Gomez: oof. that's a taxonomy problem. product should pick canonical terms.
Evan Liu: also: the docs flyout anchor uses a different fragment id than our external docs. If someone copies the link and sends to a teammate it opens the help page but not the same subsection.
Maya Chen: example deep link mismatch:
- Console link generated by flyout: https://console.redwood.ai/route/abc123#variant-panel
- External docs canonical link: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/routes?routeId=abc123&section=variant
We should standardize on the docs style so links are portable.
Ravi Patel: Docs can adopt a /docs route and add a thin redirect from /route/<id>#variant to the canonical docs URL. Also will add a short note in the flyout showing "Permalink" that copies the canonical docs link.
Clara Gomez: lexicon proposal: use 'Model variant' (model-focused) and 'Instance tier' (infra-focused). Avoid 'serving' & 'capacity' variants in UI copy to reduce ambiguity. Thoughts?
Evan Liu: I like that. 'Instance tier' reads clearer to engineers and non-technical PMs.
Maya Chen: accessibility issues: the flyout's 'Open docs' button is missing an accessible name when collapsed, and the header anchor isn't reachable by keyboard. Screenreader just says "button".
Ravi Patel: I'll update the docs examples with an aria-label suggestion and a canonical copy snippet.
Clara Gomez: action list agreed: 1) Product finalizes lexicon to "Model variant" + "Instance tier" (Clara) 2) Docs creates canonical URL patterns + permalink UX (Ravi) 3) Eng-UI updates labels and keyboard focusability, ensures aria-labels for flyout CTAs (Evan) 4) Support KB updated with examples and clarifying screenshots (Maya)
Evan Liu: I'll open a couple of small PRs: one for the i18n changes to labels, one for adding tabindex to the anchor and aria-labels. Will run axe and VoiceOver checks.
Maya Chen: timeline: try to get lexicon decision by EOD Monday, docs permalink changes by Wednesday, UI PR by end of sprint. If anyone sees more inconsistent terms (quota, quota-limit, limit-bucket etc.) add them here.
Ravi Patel: will post draft copy + link examples in #docs and attach to this thread once ready.
Clara Gomez: I'll run a 2-min poll with PMs and attach results.
Maya Chen: thanks all — small alignment but will reduce user confusion and support load. :sparkles:
